classes.A: evaluation artefact: evidence a published evaluation or feasibility study should itself carry
classes.B: governance record: evidence that exists only as organisational documents or records an auditor could inspect
classes.C: attestation: a judgement of adequacy, legitimacy or alignment that no artefact settles

classified_by: Fabio Rovai, Tesseract Academy, 11 September 2026; one rationale per cell, open to challenge by issue

DES-B6.rationale: A task specification with named metrics, test conditions and a benchmark dataset is an artefact a feasibility study publishes.

DES-C6.rationale: A workflow-level metric (time or workload saved, recall after the human step) is either reported or not.

DES-D6.rationale: Whether the evaluation feeds a lifecycle assurance framework is settled by the organisation's assurance records, not by the study.

DES-E6.rationale: Incorporation of stakeholder evidence is settled by engagement records held by the organisation.

DES-B7.rationale: The study states the intended role of the model and what stays with humans, or it does not.

DES-C7.rationale: Override, disagreement and escalation handling is part of the published workflow design.

DES-D7.rationale: Governance pause and stop points live in stage-gate records.

DES-E7.rationale: Whether oversight was designed with affected people is an engagement record.

DES-B8.rationale: Named accountable roles for scoping and approval are an organisational RACI, not a publication.

DES-C8.rationale: RACI for AI-assisted decisions is an organisational record.

DES-D8.rationale: Governance body responsibilities and resourcing are organisational records.

DES-E8.rationale: Stakeholder involvement in defining accountability is an engagement record.

DES-B9.rationale: Naming groups at risk of differential exclusion and setting an equity goal is a statement the study either makes or omits.

DES-C9.rationale: A designed check for systematic disadvantage is part of the evaluation design.

DES-D9.rationale: Governance consideration of equity is a governance document.

DES-E9.rationale: Composition of engagement participants is an engagement record.

DES-B10.rationale: Who defined acceptable error and non-delegable decisions is stated in a protocol or not.

DES-C10.rationale: A workforce impact assessment is an organisational record.

DES-D10.rationale: Involvement of professional bodies is an engagement record.

DES-E10.rationale: Whether user or professional perspectives were collected as evidence is visible in the study's methods.

DES-B11.rationale: Critical failure modes are either enumerated in the study or not.

DES-C11.rationale: Checks for over-reliance and automation bias are part of the published design or absent.

DES-D11.rationale: Lifecycle risk identification with re-evaluation plans is a risk-management record.

DES-E11.rationale: Failure modes surfaced by engagement are engagement records.

DES-B12.rationale: Stage gates in risk and impact assessments are governance records.

DES-C12.rationale: Shadow testing and controlled rollout plans are governance records.

DES-D12.rationale: An end-to-end lifecycle plan is a governance record.

DES-E12.rationale: Linkage of participation to formal governance is a governance record.

DES-B13.rationale: Intended use, non-intended use and scope statements are documentation artefacts.

DES-C13.rationale: Version-controlled workflow rules and code are either published or not.

DES-D13.rationale: Governance decision logs are organisational records.

DES-E13.rationale: Engagement documentation is an organisational record.

DES-B14.rationale: Stakeholder involvement in the adoption decision is an engagement record.

DES-D14.rationale: External oversight arrangements are governance records.

DES-E14.rationale: Feedback and appeal channels are organisational mechanisms with records.

DES-B15.rationale: A systemic impact analysis is an organisational document.

DES-C15.rationale: Labour and access impact analysis at scale is an organisational document.

DES-D15.rationale: Vendor dependence and environmental governance are governance records.

DES-E15.rationale: Whether involvement enhances legitimacy is a judgement no artefact settles.

DEV-B6.rationale: Dataset identity, size and inclusion prevalence are reported or not.

DEV-C6.rationale: Prior evidence for the model choice is cited or not.

DEV-D6.rationale: Ground truth provenance and threshold calibration against it are stated in the methods.

DEV-B7.rationale: Processes for humans to flag problematic data are organisational processes.

DEV-C7.rationale: Decoding and constraint parameters are reported or not.

DEV-D7.rationale: Whether the prompt signals uncertainty or escalation is checkable only if the prompt text is published.

DEV-B8.rationale: Roles for data selection and quality control are organisational records.

DEV-C8.rationale: Provider, integrator and deployer responsibility allocation is a contractual or governance record.

DEV-D8.rationale: Accountability for prompt design errors is an organisational record.

DEV-B9.rationale: Subgroup error rates are reported or not.

DEV-C9.rationale: Performance by language or region is measured or not.

DEV-D9.rationale: A prompt bias review is a process record.

DEV-B10.rationale: Whether the eligibility criteria given to the model are the review's own criteria is visible in the methods.

DEV-C10.rationale: Whether the configuration prioritises sensitivity, the domain norm for screening, is checkable against the reported setup.

DEV-D10.rationale: Co-design of prompts with professionals is a process record.

DEV-B11.rationale: Leakage and contamination are discussed and mitigated, or not.

DEV-C11.rationale: Known failure modes are documented and stress-tested, or not.

DEV-D11.rationale: Prompt robustness testing is reported or not.

DEV-B12.rationale: Integration into DPIAs and risk registers is a governance record.

DEV-C12.rationale: Risk-tier assignment is a governance record.

DEV-D12.rationale: Change governance for prompts is a governance record.

DEV-B13.rationale: Data provenance and limitations documentation is present or absent.

DEV-C13.rationale: Availability of a model card or equivalent for the chosen model is checkable.

DEV-D13.rationale: Verbatim prompt text plus a pinned model version and date are either published or not.

DEV-B14.rationale: Consultation on data use is an engagement record.

DEV-C14.rationale: Expert involvement in model trade-offs is a process record.

DEV-D14.rationale: Channels for flagging prompt concerns are organisational mechanisms.

DEV-B15.rationale: Systemic harm analysis of data practices is an organisational document.

DEV-C15.rationale: Lock-in and concentration management is a governance record.

DEV-D15.rationale: Speculative systemic effects of reused prompt designs are a judgement no artefact settles.

DEP-B6.rationale: Metric definitions and realistic test conditions are visible in the methods.

DEP-C6.rationale: A systematic error analysis is reported or not.

DEP-D6.rationale: The test environment and integration conditions are described or not.

DEP-E6.rationale: Analysis of interaction with systemic outcomes is an organisational document.

DEP-F6.rationale: Reporting completeness sufficient to interpret claims is checkable against the publication.

DEP-B7.rationale: Whether thresholds reflect institutional risk appetite is a judgement; the stated rationale is only a proxy.

DEP-C7.rationale: Error reporting mechanisms and protections are organisational records.

DEP-D7.rationale: Access control design is a configuration record.

DEP-E7.rationale: Tools and authority for mitigating systemic harm are organisational arrangements.

DEP-B8.rationale: Threshold ownership and trade-off protocols are governance records.

DEP-C8.rationale: Incident ownership is a governance record.

DEP-D8.rationale: Security accountability is a governance record.

DEP-E8.rationale: Systemic impact monitoring roles are governance records.

DEP-F8.rationale: Documentation ownership is a governance record.

DEP-B9.rationale: Disaggregated metrics are reported or not.

DEP-C9.rationale: Error impact analysis across groups is reported or not.

DEP-D9.rationale: Deployment-context risk exposure analysis is an organisational document.

DEP-E9.rationale: Distributional impact mapping is an organisational monitoring record.

DEP-F9.rationale: Whether documentation is understandable to diverse groups is a judgement no artefact settles.

DEP-B10.rationale: Whether thresholds prioritise recall in a safety-critical screening context is checkable.

DEP-D10.rationale: Stated and resourced expectations on professionals are organisational records.

DEP-E10.rationale: Professional community involvement is an engagement record.

DEP-F10.rationale: Guidance and training materials are internal documentation.

DEP-B11.rationale: Worst-case and tail analysis is reported or not.

DEP-C11.rationale: Red-teaming and scenario exercises are process records.

DEP-D11.rationale: Environment-specific security assessment is a security record.

DEP-E11.rationale: Systemic failure scenario analysis is an organisational document.

DEP-F11.rationale: Documented failure modes and uncertainties are present or absent in the publication.

DEP-B12.rationale: A pre-specified decision rule linking metrics to go or no-go is stated or not.

DEP-D12.rationale: Risk-tier linkage is a governance record.

DEP-E12.rationale: Sectoral governance integration is a governance record.

DEP-F12.rationale: Maintenance of transparency artefacts over time is a versioned organisational record.

DEP-B13.rationale: Confidence intervals and uncertainty are reported or not.

DEP-C13.rationale: Logs, incident reports and post-mortems are organisational records.

DEP-D13.rationale: Environment and configuration documentation is a deployment record.

DEP-E13.rationale: Energy and compute cost is measured and disclosed or not.

DEP-F13.rationale: Decision-trace logging is a deployment record; the accessibility part is a judgement.

DEP-B14.rationale: Stakeholder input on which errors matter is an engagement record.

DEP-C14.rationale: Stakeholder involvement in incident review is an engagement record.

DEP-D14.rationale: Frontline consultation is an engagement record.

DEP-E14.rationale: Civil society engagement is an engagement record.

DEP-F14.rationale: Feedback mechanisms on documentation are organisational mechanisms.

DEP-B15.rationale: Whether metric choices risk gaming is a judgement no artefact settles.

DEP-C15.rationale: Consideration of cumulative effects is an organisational document.

DEP-D15.rationale: Architecture vulnerability assessment is a security record.

DEP-E15.rationale: A decommissioning plan is a governance record.

DEP-F15.rationale: Whether communication over-sells is a judgement no artefact settles.
